neighbours.label: a Christmas tree set up, decorated or gathered around at home; neither a tree outdoors nor Christmas without the tree
fire: Last weekend my dad carried the Christmas tree up from the garage.
Once the tree is up, the kids hang the ornaments on its branches.
Our neighbours put their Christmas tree up right after Thanksgiving.
My aunt trims her tree with popcorn garlands each December.
On Christmas Eve we gathered around the tree to open gifts.
He strung lights on the tree while she unpacked the ornaments.
By January the Christmas tree was dropping needles on the rug.
Grandma keeps the angel for the top of the Christmas tree in a shoebox.
quiet: Last weekend my dad carried the old bicycle up from the garage.
Once the shelf is up, the kids hang the pictures on its brackets.
Our neighbours put their holiday cards out right after Thanksgiving.
My aunt trims her hedge with garden shears each December.
On Christmas Eve we gathered around the table to eat dinner.
He strung lights on the oak tree outside while she unpacked the ornaments.
By January the apple tree was bare and covered in frost.
Grandma keeps the recipe for the Christmas pudding in a shoebox.
